$Comment: Reusable autonomous flying follow behavior for aerial companions.

MasterTargetSlot.Description: Target slot used to track the owner/master.

FollowDesiredAltitudeRange.Description: Preferred altitude range to maintain while following.

FollowTeleportThresholdRange.Description: Distance beyond which teleport fallback is used instead of normal flight catch-up.

FollowOrbitRadiusRange.Description: Wander orbit radius range maintained around the owner.

FollowOrbitRetargetTimeRange.Description: Delay range between choosing new orbit points around the owner.

FollowOrbitStopDistance.Description: Distance from a selected orbit point considered reached.

FollowOrbitRelativeSpeed.Description: Relative speed used while wandering around the owner.

FollowHoverRadius.Description: Small hover orbit radius used when already near the owner.

FollowHoverRelativeSpeed.Description: Relative speed used for close hover/orbit behavior.

Content.$Comment: Take off when grounded, orbit the owner while airborne, and teleport only after a large separation.

Instructions.$Comment: Keep combat target released while in follow mode.
If grounded, take off before running the flying follow behavior.
Maintain a suitable airborne altitude while follow mode is active.
Teleport back to the owner if they are far beyond normal catch-up range.
Wander through a broad orbit around the owner instead of directly seeking their position.
Fallback hover if the owner target is temporarily unavailable but the companion is still airborne.
